name: Mur & Gav
tagline: We treat pets so well their tails wag even at the vet

seo.title: Mur & Gav — 24/7 vet clinic and grooming in Tashkent
seo.description: A 24/7 veterinary clinic on Bobur St: vaccinations, ultrasound, spaying, dentistry and grooming for cats and dogs. Book online or by phone.
seo.answer: Mur & Gav is a 24/7 veterinary clinic in Tashkent at 17 Bobur St. We treat cats, dogs, rabbits and ferrets: a GP consultation is 150,000 UZS, a combined vaccination from 220,000 UZS, and cat spaying 650,000 UZS. Emergency care is available 24/7 with no appointment.

listing.description: A website for a vet clinic, grooming salon or pet shop. Warm and friendly: an SVG cat, paw prints following the cursor, services with prices, doctors and a 24/7 emergency line.

sections.title: A vet clinic that isn’t scary to visit
sections.subtitle: General medicine, surgery, ultrasound, dentistry and grooming under one roof. Separate entrances and waiting rooms for cats and dogs — so nobody hisses at anybody.

sections.label: the clinic
sections.title: First we get acquainted, then we treat
sections.text: Every visit starts with five minutes to sniff around the room and some treats. Our vets take their time, explain the diagnosis in plain words and send the treatment plan on Telegram. We have our own lab, X-ray, ultrasound and a ward with cameras — you can watch your pet sleep after surgery.

sections.label: services and prices
sections.title: How we can help
sections.intro: Prices are per visit or procedure, excluding medication. The vet gives the exact cost of treatment after the examination.

items.title: Vaccination
items.text: Combined vaccine, microchip and pet passport. We’ll remind you of the next one.

items.title: GP consultation
items.text: Examination, consultation and a treatment plan on Telegram.

items.title: Grooming
items.text: Bathing, trimming, nails and ears. Our groomer works without sedation.

items.title: Ultrasound and X-ray
items.text: Abdominal and cardiac ultrasound, digital X-ray with a report.

items.title: Spaying and neutering
items.text: Cats 650,000 UZS, male dogs from 700,000 UZS. Recovery suit and follow-up check included.

items.quote: Our Musya hates her carrier and vets. This is the first clinic she’s left without a meltdown. A separate entrance for cats is genius.
items.author: Natalya
items.role: owner of Musya the British Shorthair

items.quote: The groomer trimmed our Spitz so well that the neighbours ask where we get him groomed. And no sedatives!
items.author: Gulnora

items.a: Yes, the clinic is open 24/7 with no days off. A GP and a surgeon are on duty at night, and emergency patients are seen without an appointment.

items.q: How much does spaying or neutering cost?
items.a: Spaying a cat is 650,000 UZS, neutering a tomcat 400,000 UZS, male dogs from 700,000 UZS depending on weight. The price includes anaesthesia, a recovery suit and a follow-up check.

items.q: Does my pet need preparation for surgery?
items.a: Yes: no food for 8–12 hours and no water for 2 hours beforehand. We take a blood test before surgery, and the result is ready in 30 minutes.
